{{Top}}
[[File:Mooring_Tower.jpg|thumb|right|250px|One mooring tower design on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]]]]
A '''mooring tower''' was a structure used to dock larger [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] that could otherwise not land on a solid surface.<ref name="DSD">''[[Death Star Designer]]''</ref><ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Description==
[[File:Aotc_1410.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mooring towers on Coruscant, [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]]]
The mooring towers were usually several hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height and could dock [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]-sized [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. Smaller vessels, like [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], could be docked using umbilical tubes.<ref name="ITW:OT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Spaceport/Legends|Spaceport]] towers on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] allowed docking of large [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AOTC" /> The [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] had a set of large [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] door on each side of the vessel, that could dock with mooring towers for resupply purposes.<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

[[File:Terrarium_City.jpg|thumb|200px|Transport spires to and from Terrarium City, Alderaan]]
A similar system to the mooring towers was used in [[Terrarium City]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where the spires were used for turbolift shafts into and out of the sealed [[City/Legends|city]], as well as for garbage disposal.<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

On the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]], the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] utilized modified mooring towers&mdash;fitted with extensive shield systems&mdash;as his personal command centers when visiting.<ref name="ITW:OT" /> The tower for the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] was known as the [[Emperor's Tower/Legends|Emperor's Tower]].

[[File:EmperorsTower-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|200px|The Emperor's command tower on the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], a modified mooring tower]]
An exceptionally large and massive mooring tower was the [[Imperial Freight Complex]] on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. It was here most freighter pilots hauling cargo to the planet ended up, going through extensive checks and resting out in one of the myriad [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] inside the tower.<ref name="DE">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Ralph McQuarrie]] paintings of structures on Alderaan from the production of the [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|original film]] were reused in the prequel ''Attack of the Clones'' as mooring towers on Coruscant. The painting itself was reused in ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', depicting transport spires on Alderaan.
